metrics.name: total revenue
metrics.description: Total transactional sales revenue: the sum of all order line item totals (quantity x unit_price). This is the canonical revenue measure. Do NOT use invoices.amount, sales_targets.achieved_amount, or campaign_metrics.revenue_attributed for company sales revenue.

metrics.name: average order value
metrics.description: Average revenue per order (AOV): total line revenue divided by the number of distinct orders.

metrics.name: gross margin
metrics.description: Gross profit in USD: revenue minus product cost, summed over line items. Requires joining order_items.product_id = products.product_id.

metrics.name: target attainment rate
metrics.description: Sales-target attainment: achieved amount divided by target amount for sales reps. A ratio of quota performance, not company revenue.

metrics.name: deployment success rate
metrics.expression: 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN deployments.status = 'Success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)
metrics.description: Percentage of deployments whose status is 'Success', over all deployment records. A release-quality measure; 'Failed' and 'Rolled Back' count against it.

metrics.name: incident MTTR (hours)
metrics.description: Mean time to resolution in hours: average elapsed time from created_at to resolved_at over RESOLVED IT incidents only (resolved_at IS NOT NULL). Include unresolved rows and the average is meaningless.

metrics.name: headcount
metrics.description: Total number of employees, one row per employee. Do NOT count payroll, attendance, or leave rows, which repeat per employee and would inflate the figure.

metrics.name: average salary
metrics.description: Average employee gross salary from payroll.gross_salary. Do NOT use positions.min_salary / positions.max_salary (those are pay-band bounds, not actual compensation).

metrics.name: lead conversion rate
metrics.expression: 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN leads.status = 'Converted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)
metrics.description: Percentage of leads whose status is 'Converted', over all leads. The core funnel-efficiency measure for marketing.

metrics.name: email open rate
metrics.description: Total email opens divided by total recipients, as a percentage. Aggregate the counts with SUM across sends; do not average per-row rates.

metrics.name: open critical incidents
metrics.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN sec_incidents.severity = 'Critical' AND sec_incidents.status <> 'Closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
metrics.description: Count of security incidents with severity 'Critical' that are not yet 'Closed' — the active critical-risk backlog. This is sec_incidents (security breaches), not it_incidents (IT outages).

metrics.name: MFA adoption rate
metrics.description: Percentage of system users with multi-factor authentication enabled (mfa_enabled = 1), over all sec_users.

metrics.name: patch compliance rate
metrics.expression: 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN vulnerabilities.patch_status = 'Patched' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)
metrics.description: Percentage of known vulnerabilities whose patch_status is 'Patched'. 'Unpatched', 'In Progress', and 'Accepted Risk' count against compliance.

columns.name: bounce_count

tables.name: campaign_metrics

domains.name: Security
domains.description: Cybersecurity operations covering users, access control, incidents, vulnerabilities, audits, and compliance.

tables.name: sec_users
tables.description: System users with access to organizational applications and infrastructure.

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for each system user.

columns.name: username
columns.description: Login username for the user.

columns.name: email
columns.description: User's corporate email address.

columns.name: department
columns.description: Department the user belongs to.

columns.name: role_id
columns.description: Access role assigned to the user.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Date the user account was created.

columns.name: last_login
columns.description: Timestamp of the user's most recent login.

columns.name: is_active
columns.description: Whether the user account is active: 1 for active, 0 for disabled.

columns.name: mfa_enabled
columns.description: Whether multi-factor authentication is enabled: 1 for yes, 0 for no.

tables.name: sec_roles

tables.name: access_logs
tables.description: System access logs recording every user login, resource access, and action.

columns.description: User who performed the access action.

columns.name: resource

columns.name: action

columns.name: timestamp
columns.description: Exact timestamp of the access event.

columns.name: status

columns.name: device_type

tables.name: sec_incidents
tables.description: Security incidents including breaches, intrusions, phishing attacks, and policy violations.

columns.description: Unique identifier for each security incident.

columns.name: severity

tables.name: vulnerabilities
tables.description: Known security vulnerabilities discovered in systems, applications, and infrastructure.
